edition.check: Level 5 needs a barcode match in >=2 sources: NOT MET, the input has no barcode and none of the tapes carries one (MB, Discogs). Level 4 needs one unambiguous edition with no competing edition: NOT MET. Six Discogs cassette editions of master 211928 (1951581, 18354001, 18354166, 17280904, 18354289, 4256710) all fit title, artist and format, and the input fixes no year or label. Level 3 needs one unambiguous edition from one source, or several fitting editions that ALL share one tracklist: MET. The evidence (steps 4, 6, 11, 17) shows all six Discogs tapes with the same 16 tracks and 2979 s. The musik-sammler 2001 and 2003 tapes are also listed with 16 tracks (step 12). Format Kassette rules out the CD editions. Stopping at 3.
edition.summary: Several cassette repressings (2001-2003) fit the input without a barcode, but all share the same 16-track list, so the choice does not matter.

tracklist.check: Level 5 needs >=2 independent sources of the same edition to agree on count, order and titles, with spelling variants only: MET. MusicBrainz (step 3), Discogs 1951581 (step 4) and musik-sammler tape-917995 (step 16) all give 16 tracks in order A1-B8 with identical durations (49:39). Deviations are only spelling ('Nute Bounce', 'Pitbull', 'Hast du Mut', 'Mittelfingah', 'Vack You!') and the alias 'Baktus & Orgasmus' for the A8 feature on musik-sammler, which the agent explained. musik-sammler is independent of the two databases, and the other Discogs repressings agree too. No printed tracklist was readable on the images (steps 8-10), which does not harm level 5.
tracklist.summary: MusicBrainz, Discogs and musik-sammler agree on 16 tracks, order, titles and durations, with only spelling and alias differences.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5 needs a database plus an independent primary source of the same edition (cover, booklet or label print): NOT MET. The only images are Discogs-hosted and show the J-card exterior and tape stickers, with no tracklist (steps 8-10). They are not independent of the Discogs entry and do not confirm the tracks. Level 4 needs two independent database entries or a database plus a specialised collector site: MET. MusicBrainz and Discogs are two databases, and musik-sammler.de is a specialised collector site that confirms the full tracklist. Stopping at 4.
sources.summary: Two databases plus musik-sammler.de confirm the tracklist, but no independent primary source (the cover images show no tracklist).

concerns: The result calls the MusicBrainz release (ILM 003, 2001) the 'Erstauflage'. MB does not say which Discogs edition it matches, so identifying it with Discogs 1951581 is an assumption.

The musik-sammler page 917995 is assumed to be the first edition. Its page says only 'Limited Edition', and a search snippet (step 12) also lists a 'Demotape (Extended Version)' tape from 2001. The mapping to a Discogs edition is not shown.
Catalogue number is given as 'ILM 003' (MB), while Discogs says '03' and the J-card back reads 'ILM1' (step 8). The inconsistency is not discussed.
The Discogs sides are mislabelled ('Side B', 'Side U') in tool output for 1951581, 4256710 and 18354289. This is harmless, since the positions A1-B8 are correct.
The feature credit for A8 differs: 'Bass Sultan Hengzt & King Orgasmus One' (MB) vs 'Baktus & Orgasmus' (musik-sammler). The result uses the MB version and notes the alias in reasoning only.
